_readme: Pre-registered 'After v8' rule (v8 is the final recipe) plus the author's choice of one more drill round on the otherwise idle GPU. GPU 0 = v8 seed 3: same data and base (SFT v7 s1) as v8 s1/s2. GPU 1 = v9 s1: the v8 recipe once more, starting from v8 s2 (best v8 seed on select, 83.3% alone), with fresh boards (builder seed 9; v8 used 8). Each is scored alone on select and heldout, under retry-3 and the leaderboard rule (open-vocab), and with word-level decoding if its in-queue gate passes.
